test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Maharana Pratap, a contemporary of Akbar, was a ruler of which of the following kingdoms?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Mewar__****__.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Maharana Pratap, a contemporary of Akbar was A ruler of **Mewar Dynasty**.
 
• Maharana Pratap, belongs to **Sisodia Dynasty.**
 
• Maharana Pratap was the 54th **ruler **of Mewar in line of **Sisodia's Dynasty.**
 
• **Mahrana Pratap **died at Chavand on 19 January 1597 at the age of 56.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Battle fought By Maharana Pratap:__**

 
 
• **​Battle of Haldighati(1576).**
 
• **Battle of Dewair (1582).**
 
• **Battle of Dattani (1583).**
